tweet.text:
OPENAI 🔥: Decisions API is now in general availability and can be used via APIs and the OpenAI Platform. 

> Decisions API is a Jev-like solution enabling you to build workflows based on extremely quick decisions. 

> Predicate, Choice, and Score decisions are available. 

It thinks that there is a 21% chance that the GPT-7 family will be released this year. 

Looks right 👀

Add near real-time decisions to your workflow with the Decisions API, now generally available.

Build faster, more cost-efficient apps and agents that can classify text and images, evaluate inputs, and determine what happens next without generating a full model response.
